item.title: “Patience” & “Big Hearts” Fill Warming Centers Amid Storm
item.description: Most days, Aaron Knox goes on at least one walk meandering around the streets of downtown. In a snowstorm, though, he looks for a warm room full of “big hearts” where he can stay inside. Knox found such a room this weekend in Upon This Rock Ministries’ warming center at 645 Grand Ave. The post “Patience” & “Big Hearts” Fill Warming Centers Amid Storm appeared first on New Haven Independent.
